evidence.quote: Previously, Direct Connect VIFs accepted a maximum of 100 route prefixes advertised from your on-premises network to AWS on a private or transit VIF.
You can now allocate up to 1,000 prefixes each for IPv4 and IPv6 on your VIFs on dedicated and hosted connections.
If you don't select any value, AWS applies the default allocation of 100 prefixes per address family.

evidence.heading: AWS Direct Connect introduces inbound prefix controls and higher prefix scale
